name: Each Google account sees its own empty workspace
description: Verifies a signed-in Google account is mapped to its own HIKER ERP workspace rather than another account's dataset.
steps: Sign in with Google Account A
expected: Account A can enter its own ERP workspace and only records belonging to Account A are loaded.

name: Create a purchase from an existing Raw Stock item
description: Verifies selecting a Raw Stock category and existing item fills the purchase details and saves the purchase into the selected category.
setup: Create a Raw Stock Uppers item named Upper Test with article ART-001 and unit 100 pairs/bag
expected: The name, article and unit come from the selected Raw Stock item, the purchase keeps category Uppers, and the purchase appears in the Purchase Register.

name: Create a new purchase item when Raw Stock has no matching item
description: Verifies a category with no matching Raw Stock item lets the user choose New Item and enter the purchase name and article manually.
steps: Select a Raw Stock category with no matching item
Choose New Item / Not in Raw Stock
Enter a new name and article, supplier, quantity and price
expected: The purchase saves with the selected category and the manually entered name and article.

name: Records created by one Google account do not appear in another
description: Verifies an ERP record created by Account A is not returned to Account B.
steps: Sign in as Google Account A
Create a customer named Account A Customer
Sign in as Google Account B
expected: Account B does not see Account A Customer, while Account A still sees its own customer after signing back in.

name: Deleting data in one Google account does not delete another account's data
description: Verifies destructive operations are authorized against the signed-in workspace and cannot target another account's record.
steps: Sign in as Google Account A and create Customer A
Sign in as Google Account B and create Customer B
Sign out and sign in as Account A
expected: Customer B is deleted only from Account B, and Customer A remains available to Account A.
